label.addDueDay: Tap to add a due day

empty.title: Your garden is empty
empty.body: Each debt grows into a plant as you pay it down. Smallest balance first — every debt you finish waters the next one.

form.name: Name
form.originalHint: If you're not sure, use today's balance.
form.errRequired: Fill in all six required fields.
form.errDueDay: The due day must be between 1 and 31.
form.errSave: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
form.lateFeeHint: From your card agreement. It's added automatically when a minimum is missed.

payment.title: Pay extra
payment.extraHint: Extra goes to your focus debt, the one closest to done.
payment.errFailed: Couldn't log that payment. Try again.

complete.errFailed: Couldn't mark it paid off. Try again.

detail.suggestedHint: Includes {{amount}} rolled over from debts you've paid off.
detail.rollsIntoNone: Nothing — this is the last one. Freedom after this.
detail.deleteBody: This removes the debt and its payment history. It can't be undone.
detail.errDelete: Couldn't delete this debt. Try again.
detail.addDueDay: Add a due day so the app can follow each billing cycle.

toggle.errFailed: Couldn't update the minimum. Try again.
toggle.errClosed: That billing cycle has closed, so its minimum can't be undone.
toggle.errAlready: The minimum is already logged for this cycle.

checkin.title: Check your statement
checkin.body: Match {{name}} to your latest statement. The app fills in what it has now.
checkin.errFailed: Couldn't save the check-in. Try again.
checkin.grewCard: This card grew by {{amount}} since last month. Try to keep it in the drawer while you pay it down.
checkin.grewOther: This balance grew by {{amount}} since last month. That happens. Keep watering it, one payment at a time.

lateFee.title: Late fee?
lateFee.bodyCard: Your minimum wasn't logged by {{date}}. Did your card charge a late fee?
lateFee.bodyOther: Your minimum wasn't logged by {{date}}. Was a late fee charged?

settings.title: Extra each month
settings.body: An amount you add every month on top of your minimums. It goes to your focus debt and moves your "Free by" dates closer. Leave it blank for {{zero}}.
settings.label: Extra each month

0.text: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.

1.text: Let no debt remain outstanding, except the continuing debt to love one another.

2.text: Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.

3.text: The plans of the diligent lead to profit as surely as haste leads to poverty.

4.text: I can do all this through him who gives me strength.
